description: Renovate covers the three dependency surfaces of this repo: GitHub Actions, pip requirements and Dockerfile base images. It supersedes Dependabot, which watched GitHub Actions only.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions updates into one PR. Renovate updates actions that are already SHA-pinned in place, digest and trailing version comment together; tag-referenced actions (@v7) stay on tags. config:recommended does not add digest pinning.

Group pip updates for requirements.txt and requirements-test.txt (both matched by the pip_requirements manager's default file patterns). The files use version ranges, so these PRs are mostly range-widening and vulnerability-driven.
Group base image updates for the Dockerfile stages.
The python:3.12-slim-trixie job containers in ci.yml hold the supported Python floor on purpose; never bump them.
runs-on: ubuntu-24.04 is a deliberate runner pin; runner image moves are made by hand.
discord.py is capped below 3 on purpose; a major release needs approval on the Dependency Dashboard before any PR opens.
